candidates.opening:
ABOUT VOLGREN:
Volgren was established in 1977 and is Australia’s largest and most successful bus body builder. We operate three manufacturing facilities located in Queensland, Victoria and Western Australia, along with Aftersales facilities across five states — Victoria, Queensland, Western Australia, New South Wales and South Australia. 
Volgren is part of the Marcopolo Group – a Brazilian Bus Manufacturer. It has a manufacturing presence in 12 countries, employing more than 14,000 people.
Volgren builds bus bodies for the world’s leading chassis manufacturer’s including Volvo, Scania, Mercedes, MAN and most recently we delivered Western Australia’s 100th ‘E’ bus on the Volvo chassis.
Our uncompromising manufacturing standards, class leading technology and our unmatched after sales service ensure our customers can trust in our product.
Our focus is on providing a safe working environme
key_lines: - Ability to work within a close team environment

Due to recent market shifts toward zero emission vehicles and Volgren’s strong focus on the development of innovative new bus solutions and processes. The Manufacturing Engineering team is looking to build upon a strong manufacturing team. A Junior Manufacturing Engineer is required for a 12-month fixed full-time contract. This is an excellent opportunity for a Graduate Manufacturing Engineer with approximately 2 years of manufacturing experience who is looking to develop their career in a practical production environment. The role will have a strong focus on conducting time studies to establish standard times for existing/new assembly operations and creation of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Creation and updating to Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) experience is essential to the role.
- Conducting time studies to establish standard times experience is essential to the role.
- Jig/Fixture design and assembly utilising AutoCAD or SolidWorks.
- Excellent computer skills - Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, SharePoint, SolidWorks, AutoCAD etc.
QUALIFICATIONS/EXPERIENCE:
- Bachelor’s degree in Industrial, Mechanical or Production engineering or equivalent.
- Minimum of 2 years’ experience in a manufacturing environment.
This position also requires the applicant to undertake a pre-employment medical which includes a drug and alcohol analysis, musculoskeletal evaluation and hearing test
Applicants must have the right to work and live in Australia.
